state: OPEN — needs a new reviewed mechanism; the planned slot-table extension was a no-op

correction_to_triage.triage_said: 'fetched_provider_method': add per-slot OSSL_FUNC_KEM_* witness entries naming the fetch writer; widening risk very low; 2 sites closeable.
correction_to_triage.measured: The four offsets and their OSSL_FUNC_KEM_* identifiers are ALREADY in FETCH_FAMILIES (consumer_closure.py:4970-4989, present since 7aec281b4). Extending the table is a no-op: the diff is 0 lines.
correction_to_triage.real_blocker: _reg_origin refuses when a site has more than one reaching definition (len(defs) != 1, :4381, 'never unioned'), so fetch_slot_witness bails at :5160-5162 before it ever consults the slot table.
correction_to_triage.why: These are compiler-merged call sites: one indirect call serves two distinct slots because the two branches converge on a single call instruction. The operand therefore has two reaching loads, both from the same fetch-produced EvpKem value.

what_is_established: Both call sites read fields of the single EvpKem value produced by the fetch path: writers are evp_kem_from_algorithm (src/evp/kem.rs:314-332) and the only writes to the base register are the two fetch returns at 0x2c28cf and 0x2c2aab.
Every reaching load is a distinct, table-declared slot with a distinct OSSL_FUNC_KEM_* identifier.
The negative controls hold: offset 0x20 (refcnt) is not in the table, and 0x80 on a different family names a different function, so the family binding is not widened by offset alone.

proposed_mechanism.name: merged-site witness
accepts_only_when: every reaching definition at the call site is a single-offset load from the SAME base value
that base is the one produced by the already-accepted fetch binding (exactly one family writer)
every offset is declared in the existing slot table for that family
the union of slot identifiers is recorded per site, not a single identifier
proposed_mechanism.refuses_when: any reaching definition fails any of the above; the site then keeps its current class
proposed_mechanism.why_it_is_not_a_relaxation: it replaces 'exactly one definition' with 'every definition is independently justified', which strengthens rather than weakens the requirement per reaching def; it does not accept a unioned target set without per-def justification

required_before_implementation: BOUNDARY review of the mechanism (the campaign requires independent review for a new proof rule), including a mutation control that removes one reaching-def justification and requires the site to revert
a negative control where two reaching defs come from different base values (must refuse)
a negative control where one reaching def is a load from an undeclared offset (must refuse)
a recorded decision on whether the evidence records a set of target identities or a union bound
